title: Word Count
statement:
Count how many times each word appears in a line of text.

The input is one line of lowercase words separated by spaces. It has at least one word. For each distinct word, print the word, a space, and how many times it appears, one word per line. Print the words in alphabetical order.

Input:

```text
the cat and the hat
```

Expected output:

```text
and 1
cat 1
hat 1
the 2
```

tests.stdin: b a c a b a
zebra apple mango apple zebra apple

hints: Use a map from each word to its count, and start a word at 0 the first time you see it.
Go through the words once. For each one, add 1 to its count in the map.
